artworks.title: The History of the United States
artworks.medium: etching (2 etchings on one sheet from one plate)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two historical scenes. The left panel shows a military setting, possibly a surrender, while the right panel depicts a formal meeting or an audience in a grand interior setting. In the left panel, figures in military attire overlook a group surrounded by raised bayonets. The landscape includes a mountain or hillside, suggesting an outdoor military engagement. The right panel illustrates an interior scene with elaborately dressed figures; one seated prominently while others stand or bow ceremonially. The room is adorned with heavy drapes and wall decorations, indicating an audience possibly involving a diplomat or envoy meeting with figures of authority. The drawing is detailed with outlines and shading, conveying a historical narrative.

artworks.title: The History of the United States
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a military landing scene. It shows a group of soldiers disembarking from boats in a disciplined formation. In the foreground, a mounted soldier on a horse gestures towards the direction the soldiers are heading. The background is filled with the masts and flags of numerous ships. The drawing is detailed in its depiction of military uniforms and the organized movement of the troops. The handwritten text at the bottom states that it depicts a landing of the French army in America at Rhode Island on July 11, 1780.

artworks.title: The History of the United States
artworks.medium: etching (3 etchings on one sheet from one plate)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Dieter Erich Meyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three historical scenes. The first scene depicts a group of individuals involved in a confrontation in a wooded area. The middle scene shows soldiers with rifles and bayonets under a mountainous backdrop. The final scene showcases a formal gathering in an urban setting with people standing in lines, some holding banners or flags. Each panel contains text providing context to the narrative.

artworks.title: Jacob and Rebecca before Isaac [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. N. Richard Miller
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical scene with multiple figures and a dog. The drawing features a central scene with three prominent figures. The figures are arranged around a depth with a sense of emotion reflected in their gestures. The setting includes draped fabrics and a decorative urn on a table. Additionally, there is a dog in the lower left corner. The composition uses soft lines and shading to create a gentle atmosphere and depth.

artworks.title: Landscape with Ruins, Pastoral Figures, and Trees
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with graphite and brown wash over black chalk, heightened with white chalk, on apricot-prepared paper
artworks.creditLine: Syma Busiel Fund and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This horizontal landscape showing ruins in a countryside is drawn on dark parchment-brown paper. The view is framed to the left by a tall leafy tree that reaches off the top edge of the paper and to the right by ruins made up of two columns beneath an entablature. A group of four people sit together in the middle distance at the lower center of the composition while eight animals, possibly goats, graze and rest nearby. The animals, people, ruins, and tree to the left are drawn with brown ink. More trees and buildings in the distance at the center is drawn lightly with graphite, giving it a hazy look.

artworks.title: Riveaux
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from within the ruins of an architectural structure. The scene showcases a series of towering, arched columns creating a pattern that draws the eye towards the background. The architecture and foliage dominate the view, with the sky and clouds visible through the arches and tree branches. The etching technique used in the artwork features detailed and precise lines defining the textures of the stone columns and foliage. The color palette is primarily monochromatic, with varying shades of black and white creating a dramatic composition. A large, ornate decorative element is near the base of a column. In the distance, the ruins extend with trees in the background. The image conveys a sense of aged grandeur and nature reclaiming the man-made.

artworks.title: Fountains

artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a stone archway in an underground corridor or crypt. The perspective is slightly above and to the side, revealing a view down a line of columns and arches that extend into the distance. There is no visible horizon as the scene is indoors. A person is seated on the left, near us, possibly resting against a textured stone wall. Another figure is standing further down the path, draped in a cloak. The arches are detailed with brushstrokes to convey age and texture. The scene is monochrome, using shades of brown for depth and shadow. Light and shadow highlight the architectural details and set a mysterious tone.

artworks.title: Riveaux
artworks.dimensions:

artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins with towering stone arches and dense foliage. Large stone walls with intricate details are partially covered in plants and ivy. Taller arches are visible in the center with detailed brushwork capturing textures. The image is black and white, highlighting contrasts between stone, greenery, and light.

artworks.title: Saxon Arch
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: This image features a stone archway with intricate details framing the view beyond. The architectural structure is detailed with etchings, showing weathering and texture. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black, white, and grey. In the foreground are architectural debris, including a stone with an inscription and a draped cloth. Beyond the archway are more arches and crumbling walls, partially hidden by trees and underbrush. The background shows the sky with tree branches.

artworks.title: Riveaux
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The etching depicts a ruined abbey viewed from a slightly lower left angle. Architectural arches stretch upwards towards the horizon line with detailed lines emphasizing stone texture and vines on the walls. The color palette is monochromatic with varying greys and blacks. Debris and an animal lie near a large tree root. Additional arches and structural remnants are seen in the distance, with clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Riveaux
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene featuring stone arches and columns of a ruined abbey. The viewpoint is slightly below, emphasizing the grandeur of the structure. The artwork is an etching with detailed line work. The monochromatic palette includes various shades of brown and black, creating contrast between light and shadow. Vines cover robust columns in the foreground, framing a series of arches that lead into the distance. The background shows the abbey's walls and openings revealing the sky and foliage beyond, evoking a sense of historical solitude.

artworks.title: Fountains
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an eye-level view of an overgrown architectural ruin with a tall tower on the left and a large arching structure covered in vegetation on the right. The horizon is not clearly visible as the structures and foliage fill the frame. The ruins and vegetation are detailed with fine lines, creating a precise etching-like effect. The color scheme is monochromatic with various shades of sepia and dark browns, giving a warm, historical feel. In the distance, small figures can be seen walking near the tower's base, providing scale and a human presence to the scene.

artworks.title: The Great Hall at Conway Castle
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene from an elevated viewpoint, showing the interior ruins of an old structure, possibly a grand hall. Tall, arched remnants of walls and ceilings frame the view, providing depth. Beyond the arches, a circular tower stands on the horizon, partially obscured by foliage. The brushstrokes are intricate and detailed, emphasizing textures of stone and vegetation. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of black and sepia. Lush plant life appears to reclaim the architecture, with light and shadow adding to the visual impact.

artworks.title: Riveaux
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a view from a slightly elevated position of a ruined abbey overgrown with ivy and vegetation. The horizon is not visible, with the scene filled with the ruins and trees. The etching technique used provides a detailed portrayal of the architecture and the natural landscape, with fine lines capturing the texture of the stone and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown or sepia tones typical of etchings, enhancing the historical setting. Closest to the viewer are detailed arches and columns of the abbey, partly hidden by dense vegetation. Further back, more arches and windows of the abbey are visible, blending with the surrounding trees. In the background, a cloudy sky adds texture and depth to the scene.

artworks.title: An Old Woman at the Toilet Table
artworks.artist: Jeremias Falck after Bernardo Strozzi (formerly after Johann Liss)
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The image features three individuals from the upper body up. An elderly woman is seated in profile at a vanity with two younger individuals standing around her. The elderly woman's face shows age with wrinkles, a slender nose, and styled hair adorned with flowers and a feather. One of the younger individuals is fixing her hair. The seated woman wears a voluminous dress and holds a flower. The vanity table is decorated with vases and beads. The room background is detailed with furniture and décor around the mirror.

artworks.title: Calm (Calme)
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a seascape with boats on a calm sea, a low horizon, expansive sky with clouds, sailing ships anchored on the left, smaller boats with people closer to the viewer and further out, a distant landmass with illuminated cliffs, and fine lines typical of an engraving or etching. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on shades of gray to create a peaceful atmosphere.

artworks.title: View of the Chateau d'Eu (Vue du Chateau d'Eu)
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an expansive landscape viewed from an elevated vantage point. In the distance, a townscape stretches across the horizon. The horizon is positioned slightly above the center of the image, cutting through the skyline where various architectural structures are silhouetted against the sky. The artist employs fine brushstrokes to capture textures within the terrain and sky. Rolling hills lead the eye towards the town, with their slopes textured by the brushwork to suggest grass and pathways. The color palette is a subdued monochrome, using shades of gray and black to achieve contrast and depth, emphasizing the scene's dramatic sky filled with sweeping clouds. Closest to us, figures are scattered along a winding path that leads into the scene.

artworks.title: Jacques Auguste de Thou
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Louis Elle I
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body facing slightly to the left. He has a receding hairline, short hair, a strong jawline, and a prominent nose. He wears a high-collared garment with an elaborate ruffled collar. The fabric is textured and patterned with visible stitching details. There are no visible jewelry or objects, and the background is plain with a textured pattern. The portrait is set within an oval frame, surrounded by a border with text and decorative elements.

artworks.title: Chancellor Michel Le Tellier
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.creditLine: Dr. and Mrs. Ronald R. Lubritz Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper half. He has a long face with a mustache and a small goatee. His hair is curly, shoulder-length, and parted in the middle. He wears a formal garment with a large collar, decorative elements, an ornamental sash, and an intricate star-shaped emblem on his upper left sleeve. There are no visible objects or jewelry. The background has a textured pattern.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Caesar: The Elephants
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a parade or procession featuring elephants and various figures. The scene includes people, horses, and elephants, along with torches emitting flames. Figures in classical attire are carrying vessels. The elephants are decorated with fabric showing ornate patterns. The artwork includes statues and carved figures among the torches. Rich linework creates a tapestry-like feel.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome Hearing the Trumpet of the Last Judgment
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and engraving with surface tone on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man sitting against a rock with one arm extended upwards. He has a slightly tilted head and is looking upwards with a concentrated expression. The man has long, unkempt hair and a beard, and is draped in cloth covering his lower body. Beside him on the ground are a skull, an open book, and some papers. The background consists of etched lines representing cloudy skies and a hand holding a trumpet, with rocky terrain.

artworks.title: Light Artillery Officer of the  Imperial Guard (Officier d'artillerie legerie de la  garde imperiale)
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical cavalry scene. It features a rider on a rearing horse swiftly moving across rough terrain with broken cart pieces and structures resembling a small village in the background. The rider is in elaborate attire, including a plumed hat, suggesting importance or rank. Other similar figures on horseback are partially visible in the right background. The style of the drawing includes detailed lines and shading to create depth, resembling a lithograph and resulting in a monochrome but detailed depiction.

artworks.title: Horse Devoured by a Lion (Cheval devore par un lion)
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a lion with its prey. The lion is focused on an animal it has felled. The scene is set against a rocky background. The lion’s expression and posture convey dominance and the cycle of life in nature. The details in the animal's mane and the texture of the cave walls are depicted with intricate line work. The drawing is monochromatic.

artworks.title: View of a Garden
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image features a grand garden scene with numerous elegantly dressed figures engaged in various activities. The garden is structured and detailed, with symmetrical paths, a central fountain, and sculpted hedges. In the background, there are trees leading to a domed building, a spire, a windmill, and an ornate building with arched windows. The artwork is created with fine line work typical of etching, using varying shades of sepia for a historical atmosphere.
